title: Sector counts of up days
statementMd:
For each sector count ticker-days that closed higher than they opened.

Expected columns: `sector`, `up_days`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT t.sector, COUNT(*) AS up_days FROM prices p JOIN tickers t ON t.symbol = p.symbol WHERE p.close > p.open GROUP BY t.sector;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
